articles.title: Samson Mow tips Elon Musk will 'go hard' into Bitcoin in 2026
articles.summary: Samson Mow, founder of Jan3, predicts that billionaire investor Elon Musk will aggressively enter the Bitcoin market by 2026. This is one of five bold predictions Mow made concerning Bitcoin's future. The forecast highlights potential major shifts in cryptocurrency investment driven by prominent tech figures, indicating a growing mainstream interest and adoption of digital assets in the coming years.

articles.title: Malwarebytes blocking Trojan.Injector
articles.summary: A user reported encountering issues with their Malwarebytes antivirus software, prompting the execution of the Farbar Recovery Scan Tool (FRST) for system diagnosis. The provided text contains the detailed scan results from FRST, indicating a technical troubleshooting process for a potential malware infection or system anomaly. This highlights practical steps in cybersecurity problem resolution.
